feedback_by_option.fil: Tourniquet ang mahigpit na tali, at nakapipinsala ito ayon sa aralin. Tanggihan ito nang magalang.
feedback_by_option.en: A tight cord is a tourniquet, which the lesson lists as harmful. Decline it kindly.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Panatilihin siyang kalmado at hindi gumagalaw, saka ayusin ang transport.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Keep him calm and as still as possible, then arrange transport.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi siya dapat maglakad. Panatilihin siyang hindi gumagalaw at hayaang ang transport ang pumunta sa kanya.
feedback_by_option.en: He should not walk. Keep him still and let transport come to him.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag habulin ang ahas. Ang oras at ang nakita ang iulat.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not chase the snake. Report the time and what you see instead.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag lagyan ng yelo. Kasama ito sa mapanganib na shortcut sa aralin.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not apply ice. It is on the lesson's list of harmful shortcuts.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Iulat ang oras ng kagat at ang nakita habang inaayos ang transport.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Report the bite time and your observations while transport is arranged.
